sources.title: Guia escrito do Mundo 1
sources.snippet: With the first stage, you can get used to the controls for the game. You can destroy the bush or proceed with a device using a torch. It is not difficult to get purple coins or star peace yet. It is completely clear only when all purple coins and star pieces are obtained, so refer to the image above for detailed location. Even if you don't get all of them when you first proceed, don't worry as the existing progress is saved when you enter again. "1-5 Secret Forest", a stage that you can go to while 1-1 is in progress, and "1-1 Kanterbury Forest Passage 1" to proceed to 1-2, do not require a guide. There is a new stage, "1-7 Guardian's Forest", which opens upon receiving the quest. You'll have a little disagreement with Elf, but if you defeat the poachers and save the forest, you can clear the misunderstanding with Elf and complete the quest. In the case of "1-2 Kanterbury Forest Passage 2", which is the connecting stage to the next stag
